plugins.name: owner
plugins.description: Forty-four commands that help run a small business, from one link or /owner: cash and payroll, bills, invoices, the month-end close and tax-season papers, leads and outreach, the CRM, ads, content and reviews, proposals, contracts and grants, the inbox, hiring and stock, and a Monday brief. It works with the tools the owner already has connected in their AI app, or a file, a PDF or a pasted email, and nothing is sent, posted, paid or written to their systems without their yes.
